create.title: Create location
create.description: Add a zone, aisle, rack, bin or any other place where stock can be kept.

update.title: Edit location
update.description: Change how this location is named, used and measured.

move.title: Move location
move.description: Choose a new parent. The location and everything inside it must be empty.

block.title: Block location
block.description: A blocked location keeps its stock but cannot receive or release it. Everything inside it is blocked too.

barcode.title: Change barcode
barcode.description: Leave the field empty to generate a new barcode. Labels printed with the old barcode stop working.

bulk.title: Generate locations
bulk.description: Build a whole branch at once. Every level is created inside each location of the level above.
bulk.tooMany: That is more than {{max}} locations. Reduce the counts.
bulk.badOrder: Each level must sit below the one before it.

parent.label: Parent location
parent.placeholder: Choose a parent (leave empty for the top level)

isStockable.label: Can hold stock
isStockable.description: Only the lowest level of a branch can hold stock.

isReceivable.label: Receivable
isReceivable.description: Purchases and returns can be received here.

applyToDescendants.label: Apply the purpose to everything inside
applyToDescendants.description: Also resets pickable and receivable on those locations.

cascade.label: Also deactivate everything inside
cascade.description: Active locations inside this one are deactivated too.

list.title: Locations
list.description: The places inside this warehouse where stock can be kept.

search.placeholder: Search by code, name or barcode

empty.title: No locations yet
empty.description: Create a location or generate a whole branch to start organizing this warehouse.

delete.title: Delete location?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be permanently deleted. This only works for locations that were never used.

deactivate.title: Deactivate location?
deactivate.description: “{{name}}” will stop accepting stock. It must be empty and not used by open documents.
